notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR2: a control heading or detail ends by the LAST DETAIL line, a control footing by the FOOTING line. With no LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase BindReportDescriptionClauses sets the control heading limit to LAST DETAIL, and that phrase is a 2002 form refused at 85 (report-page-forms-2002, VisitReportPageSubclause), so the 1985 limits always hold; ScreenReportGroupLines refuses an absolute line past them (COBOL2199) and PresentBody fits against LowerLimit. Witnesses: 1985-GR-XIII_3_10_8-2 and pb5242-page-forms-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985: CH and DE lower limit is LAST DETAIL; CF lower limit is FOOTING. 2023 §2023:13.18.57.4 GR8 d) 'The lower limit for a control heading is the line given by the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer', e) DE LAST DETAIL, f) CF FOOTING; §2023:13.18.39.4 GR2 e). The LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase is accepted by 2023 and absent from 1985's PAGE clause, so a CH limit different from LAST DETAIL is a case added; when it is omitted §2023:13.18.39.4 GR3 c) 'integer-5 will be equal to integer-6, if LAST DETAIL is specified', the 1985 value.
